question: What is the common name of Parthenium hysterophorus?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Carrot Grass__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Parthenium hysterophorus L, commonly known as carrot weed white top or congress grass in India, is an herbaceous, erect and annual plant belonging to the family Asteracae (compositae).
 
• It is most popularly known as gajar ghas due to its appearance like carrot plant.​
